NEET PG State Counselling

50% of government MD/MS seats and private college seats are filled through state counselling. Find your state's authority and colleges.

Domicile matters

State quota PG seats usually require MBBS from that state or state domicile; in-service quotas also apply in many states.

Separate registration

Each state runs its own registration, fee, merit list and choice filling — independent of MCC. You can take part in both.

Private colleges

Private college PG seats (government & management quota) are allotted by the state authority.
